BuildRouterFromSource.description:
A file provider used for building the Router from source at a specific git commit
or reference.

commit_ref.description:
A git reference that can be passed to `git checkout`. This may be
a full or partial commit hash, branch name, or tag.

Defaults to `"main"` if unset.

rust_version.description:
A Rust version string that can be passed to `rustup run {rust_version}`,
such as `"1.78.0"`, `"beta"`, or `"nightly"`.

Defaults to `"stable"` if unset.

BuildRouterFromSource.title: Build Router From Source

file_providers.description: File providers to run and make available prior to execution

CommandSection.title: Command Section

GithubFile.description:
The user specifies a path to a file within a GitHub repository, optionally providing a specific
ref of the repository to pull the file from. If no ref is providing then the provider will pull
the version of the file found on the default branch.

git_ref.description:
An optional git reference to pull the file from. This may be a full or partial commit hash,
branch name, or tag.

Defaults to the mainline branch as specified in GitHub if unset.

org.description: The GitHub org for the repository containing the target file

path.description: The absolute path from the root of the repository to the target file

repo.description: The GitHub repository containing the target file

GithubFile.title: GitHub File

GraphosCannedOps.description:
The user specifies the graph ref and parameters that should be used to
generate canned GraphQL requests based on operations data obtained from
the GraphOS API.

```yaml
- name: canned_ops.json
  env_var: CANNED_OPS_FILE
  kind: graphos_canned_ops
  graph_ref: graph@variant
  top_n: 10
  skip_mutations: false
```

graph_ref.description: The Apollo graph ref to pull operations for.

skip_mutations.description:
Whether or not to include mutations in the returned operations.

Defaults to false if unset.

top_n.description:
The number of operations to attempt to fetch.

Defaults to 20 if unset.

GraphosCannedOps.title: GraphOS Canned Operations

GraphosSubgraphDockerCompose.description:
The user specifies the graph ref that should be used to fetch the supergraph
SDL file from the GraphOS API and generates a docker compose file. It runs a
configurable number of subgraph services, mocking based on the supergraph
schema behind a loadbalancer.

```yaml
- name: "subgraph-compose.yaml"
  env_var: SUBGRAPH_COMPOSE
  kind: graphos_subgraph_docker_compose
  graph_ref: graph@variant
  image: ghcr.io/apollographql/runtime-testing-framework/router-scale-subgraph:main
  command:
  - -schema
  - /app/supergraph.graphql
  replicas: 5
  resource_limits:
    cpus: '0.5'
    memory: 1G
  resource_reservations:
   cpus: '0.1'
    memory: 512M
  mem_swappiness: 0
  loadbalancer:
    resource_limits:
      cpus: '0.5'
      memory: 1G
    resource_reservations:
      cpus: '0.1'
      memory: 512M
    mem_swappiness: 0
```

command.description:
The command that subgraph server image runs.

Defaults to "-schema /app/supergraph.graphql" if unset.

graph_ref.description: The Apollo graph ref to pull the supergraph for.

image.description:
The image the subgraph service runs.

Defaults to ghcr.io/apollographql/runtime-testing-framework/router-scale-subgraph:main if unset.

loadbalancer.description: The configuration for the subgraph's loadbalancer.

mem_swappiness.description:
Enable or disable memory swapping in the subgraph services.

Defaults to 0 (disabled) if unset.

replicas.description:
The number of subgraph services containers running.

Defaults to 5 if unset.

resource_limits.description:
The resource limits for the subgraph containers.

Defaults to cpus=0.5 and memory=1G if unset.

resource_reservations.description:
The reserved resources for the subgraph containers.

Defaults to cpus=0.1 and memory=512M if unset.

GraphosSubgraphDockerCompose.title: GraphOS Supergraph Docker Compose

GraphosSubgraphRouterUrlOverrides.description:
The user specifies the graph ref that should be used to fetch subgraph
SDL files from the GraphOS API and generates a the override_subgraph_urls
YAML snippet that can be merged into a router config file

This should be used when generating the subgraph docker compose using
[GraphosSubgraphDockerCompose]. This will ensure the router subgraph urls
map to the loadbalancer url in that compose file.

```yaml
- name: subgraph-url-overrides.yaml
  env_var: SUBGRAPH_URL_OVERRIDES
  kind: graphos_subgraph_router_url_overrides
  graph_ref: graph@variant
  url_format: localhost
```

graph_ref.description: The Apollo graph ref to pull the subgraphs for.

url_format.description: The format of the overrides url.

GraphosSubgraphRouterUrlOverrides.title: GraphOS Supergraph Router URL Overrides

GraphosSubgraphs.description:
The user specifies the graph ref that should be used to fetch a subgraph
SDL files from the GraphOS API.

Note that this file proivider will output a directory of SDL schema files, one for each
subgraph.

```yaml
- name: "subgraphs"
  env_var: SUBGRAPHS
  kind: graphos_subgraphs
  graph_ref: graph@variant
```

graph_ref.description: The Apollo graph ref to pull subgraph SDL files for.

GraphosSubgraphs.title: GraphOS subgraph SDL

GraphosSupergraph.description:
The user specifies the ref that should be used to fetch a supergraph SDL
file from the GraphOS API.

```yaml
- name: "supergraph.graphql"
  env_var: SUPERGRAPH
  kind: graphos_supergraph
  graph_ref: graph@variant
  with_supergraph_overrides: null
```

graph_ref.description: The Apollo graph ref to pull supergraph SDL for.

with_subgraph_overrides.description:
Replace the supergraph's subgraph urls with overridden values for testing.

Defaults to null if unset.

GraphosSupergraph.title: GraphOS Supergraph SDL

MergeYaml.description:
Merge the YAML output of two text based file providers into a single YAML file.

Matching keys in the overrides file will replace scalar values, concatenate arrays
and merge keys for maps.
